name: claudetto
description: Adds a lean output style, a main agent with a roster of six agents, a permission gate that answers each permission prompt, a status line command with the plan usage, and the `setup` skill. Adds the MiniSpec skills `propose`, `apply`, `verify`, `archive`, `explore`, `update`, and `sync`, a handover to a fresh session in place of the compaction summary, a `goal` check and a check of each ticked task, a ledger of edited files, and a cleanup at session start. With a key, Jev answers `AskUserQuestion`, the asks of the gate, and the handover offer.

decide.title: Second Opinion
decide.description: Use `off` for no pick, or `jev` for Jev (it needs `TYPESAFE_API_KEY`, and the questions go to the TypeSafe API). With `jev` and the key, Jev answers each `AskUserQuestion` call and the dialog does not show, unless Jev is not sure about a question.

compaction.title: Compaction
compaction.description: Use `auto` to pick a handover or a compaction for each case from the table, `handover` to hand over at each trigger, `built-in` for the compaction of Claude Code, or `code` for a compaction that code builds with no model request.

plan.title: Plan
plan.description: The plan tier of the login, such as `default_claude_max_20x`. `claudetto-setup` writes it from `~/.claude.json`. Keep it empty for an API key or an unknown tier.

TYPESAFE_API_KEY.title: TypeSafe API Key
TYPESAFE_API_KEY.description: The key of Jev for the `decide` option. Claude Code keeps it in secure storage, not in a settings file.
